analysis_audit: The weight grid was frozen before execution. An instrument-matched comparator and an element-system-plus-instrument shuffle were added after the initial implementation dry run revealed that 1,058 of 1,069 weak-positive pair instances share an instrument. Final judgments use the source-adjusted analysis and remain exploratory.
scope: HTEM thin-film sample libraries; composition and deposition settings only
property_policy: No property, performance, structure outcome, morphology outcome, thickness, diffraction result, or measurement target is retained or used.
expert_policy: No expert labels, expert scoring, or expert-based cluster naming.
method_and_sequence_policy: Synthesis-method names and process order are outside the HTEM Phase 2 scope because the dataset represents a common thin-film deposition setting schema and contains no explicit event sequence.

missingness_policy.reported_similarity: computed only from settings reported for both libraries
missingness_policy.unreported_weight: not redistributed; it widens the supported-to-possible similarity interval
missingness_policy.partial_arrays: reported slots are compared; unreported slots widen the interval
missingness_policy.zero: retained as an explicitly reported setting

material_distance.reported: conditional distance among jointly reported settings; falls back to composition when no setting is shared

clustering.algorithm: average-linkage agglomerative clustering on precomputed dissimilarity
clustering.reason: pair-specific reporting subspaces need not satisfy Euclidean geometry; Ward and k-means are not used

support_and_controls.weak_positive: different sample libraries linked to the same HTEM study
support_and_controls.unlabeled: all pairs without a shared study; never called negative
support_and_controls.support_role: descriptive support only; never used to tune weights or cluster resolution

exploratory_judgment.rule: The phase is informative if at least one prespecified profile and resolution yields an interpretable, reproducible cluster or material-pair pattern. A universal best similarity is not required.
minimum_evidence_for_context_supported_p: positive excess co-assignment relative to composition-matched unlabeled pairs
positive excess after matching the unlabeled comparison on deposition instrument as well as composition distance
not reproduced equally by reporting-mask-only or instrument-only control
all prespecified profiles and resolutions disclosed
exploratory_judgment.novel_pattern_policy: A cross-study pattern may be retained as a hypothesis when its composition and process basis is mechanically describable and stable; it is not declared scientifically correct without downstream validation.
